create_bbb_agent: create a Bayes by Backprop agent using BBBConfig with hidden sizes and learning rate settings
configure_bbb_agent: configure a BBB agent with analytical or sample-based KL divergence methods for variational inference
build_bbb_loss_fn: build an ELBO loss function with categorical log-likelihood and model prior KL for classification tasks
setup_bbb_network: setup a Bayes by Backprop ENN network with configurable hidden layer sizes and temperature scaling
apply_batch_strategy: apply a batch strategy that scales training steps based on the ratio of training data to input dimension
